overview.title: Tora Python SDK
overview.tagline: Experiment tracking built for speed and simplicity.
highlights: Track metrics, hyperparameters, tags, and metadata with minimal setup.
Buffered logging keeps training loops fast while still streaming results.
Experiments stay linked to workspaces with ergonomic auth defaults.

globalFunctions.name: setup
globalFunctions.summary: Initialize a global experiment session and return its id.
globalFunctions.signature: setup(name, workspace_id=None, description=None, hyperparams=None, tags=None, api_key=None, server_url=None, max_buffer_len=1) -> str

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Workspace to attach the experiment to.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Authentication key (falls back to env by default).

parameters.name: max_buffer_len
parameters.description: Buffer size before flush. Defaults to 1.

notes: Prints the experiment URL to the console on creation.
